steps.observation:
[Search] Results for 'Which song was released more recently, GoAheadAndBreakMyHeartHeart or KneeDeepInMyHeart?':
[Doc 1] Knee Deep in My Heart: The song was released as a single on 29 November 2013.

[Doc 2] Go Ahead and Break My Heart: The recording's release was accompanied by two live performances of the song later that day on both" The Voice" and at a promotional i HeartRadio concert.

[Doc 3] Feel Good Hit of the Summer: Upon the album's release," Feel Good Hit of the Summer" had particular attention drawn to it due to the song's focus on drugs.

[Doc 4] I Could Stay: The song was written by Kreesha Turner, Erika Nuri and Greg Ogan.

[Doc 5] Whiplash (Metallica song): It was released as the first single from their debut album," Kill' Em All".
